Best of Red Sea::14.programme:
Program
Day 1: Meet & greet at the airport. Group transfer to the port. Onboarding, meeting the crew & briefing. Days 2-7: Departure in the morning. North wrecks — Salem Express, Sha’ab Abu Nuhas (Giannis D + Carnatic), SS Thistlegorm. Ras Mohamed + Tiran — Shark Reef & Yolanda, Jackson Reef, Thomas Reef, Gordon Reef. Brothers Islands — 2 days. Big Brother wrecks (Numidia + Aida), Little Brother, grey reef sharks, oceanic whitetips. Daedalus Reef — 2 days. Hammerheads, pristine walls, 60 miles offshore. Sataya + Fury Shoals — Spinner dolphins, Sha’ab Claudio caves, Abu Galawa. St. John’s Reef — 2 days. 300+ coral species, Dangerous Reef, The Abyss, night dives. Elphinstone — Final dives. Oceanic whitetips on the south plateau year-round. Day 8: Check-out from the yacht, group transfer to the airport. Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons

Brothers - Daedalus - Elphinstone::7.programme:
Program
Day 1: Meet & greet at the airport. Group transfer to the port. Onboarding, meeting the crew & briefing. Days 2-7: Departure in the morning. Boat, diving, safety, and Scientific equipment briefing. Onboard briefing. Orientation dives. The Brother Islands are one of the best diving spots in the world. The Islands – the Big Brother and the Little Brother– are two small isolated promontories that just come out of the water in the middle of the sea at some 60 km from the coast. The Little Brother has a very high concentration of life in a very reduced area. The walls are covered literally with sponges, anemones, and all sorts of soft coral alcyonarian in an astonishing variety of colors and shapes. Of course, you will find here plenty of fish. It is not unusual to see sharks: hammerheads, thresher sharks, grey sharks, silvertip, and white-tip reef sharks. About one km north of the Little Brother lies the Big Brother. Situated, in the middle of the island, is a lighthouse. When it is not too windy, you can proceed to dive into the wreck “Numidia” which lies upon the reef on the northern side of the island between 10 and 80 m. This 150 m long ship sunk 100 years ago and is now completely covered with both hard and soft corals and gorgonias. A fantastic view! On the NW side of the island, you will find another wreck: the “AIDA“. This 82 m long steam ship sunk in 1957. The remaining pieces of the wreck are scattered all over the reef and just a small section of the hull can be found between 30 and 60 m. It is nicely overgrown and worth visiting. Because of strong currents and possibly high waves, it is not easy to dive at the Brothers. This safari is only for experienced divers. Day 8: Check-out from the yacht, group transfer to the airport. Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons

Brothers, Safaga Reefs::7.programme:
Program
Day 1: Meet & greet at the airport. Group transfer to the port. Onboarding, meeting the crew & briefing. Days 2-7: Departure in the morning. Boat, diving, safety, and Scientific equipment briefing. Onboard briefing. Orientation dives. The Red Sea islands are characterized by many coral reefs that fascinate the eyes with their splendor, and of course, the Brother Islands are characterized by coral reefs of various shapes and colors. Sharks like hammerheads, grey sharks, silver sharks, and white reef-tipped sharks. The Aida shipwreck that located southeast facing the coast of Big Brothers Island, which is one of the most visited shipwrecks in the Red Sea. The Numidia shipwreck that crashed into the rocks on Big Brother Island, which considered one of the most wonderful wrecks in the Red Sea. Brothers Islands Lighthouse has been active since the 19th century. Day 8: Check-out from the yacht, group transfer to the airport. Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons

Deep South, St. Johns::7.programme:
Program
Day 1: Meet & greet at the airport. Group transfer to the port. Onboarding, meeting the crew & briefing. Days 2-7: Departure in the morning. Boat, diving, safety, and Scientific equipment briefing. Deep, deep in the south - near Rocky Island - are the St. John’s Reefs. You will find their exciting drop-offs. The wall of one of the reefs is overgrown with big gorgonians, and the wall of the other reef is overgrown with all kinds of colorful soft corals. You will find a lot of fish, and in the blue, you can see with a little bit of luck “big fish” like Hammerheads, Grey sharks, Silvertip, White Tip Reef Sharks, Barracudas, Tunas, and Mackerels. Sometimes even you can see Mantas and dolphins. It is possible to reach St. John’s Reefs in one week, but you are going to sail a lot (mostly at night) and the time is very short to dive at all the reefs in St. John’s. Because of the long distance, some groups decide to do a 10 or 13 day safari cruise in combination with Abu Fendera. Abu Fendera Reef. The main reef is around 6 km long and full of hard coral. In front of this reef, you can see some parts like a small reef or ergs, which are 400 - 800 meters. You can go diving between the reefs. So, you can plan and make a lot of different dives there. In front of the reefs, you will see a lot of ergs. And there are the most beautiful soft corals. Also, you can see a lot of fish. Day 8: Check-out from the yacht, group transfer to the airport. North - Straits of Tiran::7.programme:
Program
Day 1: Meet & greet at the airport. Group transfer to the port. Onboarding, meeting the crew & briefing. Days 2-7: Departure in the morning. Boat, diving, safety, and Scientific equipment briefing. Onboard briefing. Orientation dives. The most famous wreck in the Red Sea: Thistlegorm, the Greek cargo ship Giannis D, the steamship Carnatic, a steam and sail-powered vessel the Dunraven, the cargo of the Cypriot freighter Yolanda. The Gordon Reef: a variety of shark species, huge moray eels, triggerfish, surgeons, jacks, parrotfish, and small wrasse, large Napoleons. The Thomas Reef: stony coral forms, Lyretail cod, and other groupers, rabbitfish and wrasse, and pufferfish. The Woodhouse Reef and the Jackson Reef. North Classic::7.programme:
Program
Day 1: Meet & greet at the airport. Group transfer to the port. Onboarding, meeting the crew & briefing. Days 2-7: Departure in the morning. Boat, diving, safety and Scientific equipment briefing. Onboard briefing. Orientation dives. The SS Thistlegorm wreck dive site. The Thistlegorm is the best-known and most popular wreck dive in the Red Sea. It lies on the west coast of the Sinai Peninsula and 40 km from Sharm El Sheikh, The Thistlegorm sank after just 18 months after her launch in April 1940. It was carrying military equipment during World War II, such as Morris cars, Bedford Trucks, motorcycles, spare tank and aircraft parts, grenades, guns, munitions, mines, artillery, and much more that made it one of the best diving sites in the Red Sea. In the early hours of the 6th of October 1941, the Thistlegorm was split in 2 and sank almost instantly after being hit by "2" bombs from a German long-range bomber. The Thistlegorm wreck is one of the best diving sites in the Red Sea. In fact, one of the best diving sites in the world. The Dunraven wreck diving. The Dunraven, a steam and sail-powered vessel used to transport spices and timber, ran aground the reef Shaab Machmud in March 1876 during a voyage from Bombay to Newcastle and sank quickly. The ship broke in two, and her two halves came to rest on the sea floor. The wreck lies upside down with the stern at a depth of 28 m and the bow at 18 m. At the stern, you find the propeller and the rudder, which are overgrown with corals. Inside the wreck, you see thousands of glassfish Shark and Yolanda reef dive site. You will also enjoy another more than wonderful scuba diving experience in Sharks and Yolanda reef, which is rated as one of the top ten dive sites, not just in the Red Sea but in the world, with wonderful marine life, where the coral reefs are a colorful and great variety. Divers flock to Yolanda reef to explore the remains of the Yolanda, an old Cypriot cargo ship that ran aground in 1980. Day 8: Check-out from the yacht, group transfer to the airport. Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons

North Wrecks::7.programme:
Program
Day 1: Meet & greet at the airport. Group transfer to the port. Onboarding, meeting the crew & briefing. Days 2-7: Departure in the morning. The best wreck diving safari in the Northern Red Sea. The North Wrecks is the ultimate Red Sea liveaboard route for wreck divers. Six historic shipwrecks spanning from 1941 WWII cargo ships to a 1991 passenger ferry - every dive day includes a wreck, and most include a night dive to experience the same hull in a completely different light. The route runs north from Hurghada through the Safaga offshore reefs (Salem Express, Middle Reef, Panorama), then into the Strait of Gubal where the most legendary wrecks of the Red Sea cluster: SS Thistlegorm, Giannis D at Sha’ab Abu Nuhas, Rosalie Moller, and the Gubal Island sites. All levels of wreck diver welcome - from the relatively shallow Giannis D (4–27m) to the deep technical territory of the Rosalie Moller (mast at 17m, deck at 35–40m). Night dives on this route are exceptional: the Thistlegorm becomes an eerie, torch-lit time capsule; Middle Reef transforms with hunting cephalopods; Tobi Arba’a’s pinnacles come alive with Spanish dancers and decorator crabs; and The Barge at Gubal Island is considered one of the finest night dives in the northern Red Sea. SS Thistlegorm - world’s most famous WWII wreck - dawn + night dive from liveaboard. Giannis D - most accessible wreck at Sha’ab Abu Nuhas - 4–27m. Salem Express - Egyptian passenger ferry 1991 - emotional, powerful dive. Rosalie Moller - WWII sister ship of Thistlegorm - sunk 48 hrs later, intact at 35–50m. 5 night dives - Middle Reef, Tobi Arba’a x2, Thistlegorm, The Barge at Gubal. Day 8: Check-out from the yacht, group transfer to the airport. Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons

Day 1: Onboarding, meeting the crew & briefing. Day 2: 3 dives in Hurghada. Day 3: 3 dives in Brothers Islands. Day 4: 4 dives, 3 dives in Ras Mohammed, and 1 night dive in alternatives. Day 5: 3 dives in SS Thistlegorm, 1 night dive in Gubal island. Day 6: 4 dives, 1 in Shark Yolanda reef, 1 Jack Fish Alley, 1 in Anemone City, and 1 night dive. Day 7: 2 dives, 1 in Shaab El Erg, 1 in Small Giftun Island. Day 8: Check-out from the yacht. Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons (Please note that night dives are not allowed in Marine Parks)

Best of Wrecks::7.programme:
Program
Day 1: Meet & greet at the airport. Group transfer to the port. Onboarding, meeting the crew & briefing. Day 2: Start the week with a check dive before heading north for an afternoon wreck dive at Abu Nuhas followed by a night dive. Day 3-4: The next two days are spent cruising the wrecks of the northern Red Sea. Normally you will have the opportunity to make three day dives and a night dive each day. The exact itinerary and order of dive sites will vary depending on the conditions, but you can expect to visit plenty of wrecks including the world-famous Thistlegorm, Ghiannis D, Carnatic, Rosalie Moller and potentially even more. Day 5: Visit the Salem Express and Al Kafain, two large ferry wrecks close to Sha'ab Sheer in Safaga. Day 6: A day at the Big Brother Island where the wrecks of Aida and Numidia are located. Day 7: Enjoy two final morning wreck dives at El Minya (a minesweeper) and Mohamed Hassabella (a fishing trawler) close to the port of Hurghada allowing you to cruise into harbour in the early afternoon. Take advantage of an evening onshore to purchase souvenirs and enjoy Egypt's famous hospitality before your journey home the next day. Day 8: Check-out from the yacht, group transfer to the airport. Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons (Please note that night dives are not allowed in Marine Parks)

Days 3-6: Spend four days cruising the northern Red Sea. Normally you will have the opportunity to make three day dives and a night dive each day. The exact itinerary and order of dive sites will vary depending on the conditions but you can expect to visit plenty of wrecks including Thistlegorm, Dunraven, Giannis D, Carnatic and potentially even more. There is also some fantastic reef diving including the Ras Mohamed marine park, Danaba (Shag Rock), Sha'ab El Erg (famous for dolphin encounters) and the Island of Gubal. Day 7: Enjoy two relaxed morning dives close to Hurghada allowing you to cruise into the harbour in the early afternoon. Best of Wrecks::7.programme:
Program
Day 1: Meet & greet at the airport. Group transfer to the port. Onboarding, meeting the crew & briefing. Day 2: Start the week with a check dive before heading north for an afternoon wreck dive at Abu Nuhas followed by a night dive. Days 3-4: The next two days are spent cruising the wrecks of the northern Red Sea. Normally you will have the opportunity to make three day dives and a night dive each day. The exact itinerary and order of dive sites will vary depending on the conditions but you can expect to visit plenty of wrecks including the world-famous Thistlegorm, Ghiannis D, Carnatic, Rosalie Moller and potentially even more. Day 5: Visit the Salem Express and Al Kafain, two large ferry wrecks close to Sha'ab Sheer in Safaga. Day 6: A day at the Big Brother Island where the wrecks of Aida and Numidia are located Day 7: Enjoy two final morning wreck dives at El Minya (a minesweeper) and Mohamed Hassabella (a fishing trawler) close to the port of Hurghada allowing you to cruise into the harbour in the early afternoon. Take advantage of an evening onshore to purchase souvenirs and enjoy Egypt's famous hospitality before your journey home the next day. Day 8: Check-out from the yacht, group transfer to the airport. Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons (Please note, that night dives are not available in Marine Parks)

Brothers, Daedalus, Elphinstone, Salem E.programme:
Program
Day 1: Meet & greet at the airport or hotel. Transfer to the port, check-in, onboard briefing and overnight in port. Day 2: Cruise south towards Safaga. Orientation dive at Ras Disha, followed by dives at the Salem Express wreck and a night dive. Overnight crossing to the Brothers Islands. Day 3: Full day at the Brothers Islands with up to three dives on Big and Little Brother. Optional lighthouse visit in the afternoon. Days 4-5: Two full days at Daedalus Reef. Expect spectacular wall dives, strong currents and excellent chances for pelagic encounters. Day 6: Early morning dives at the world-famous Elphinstone Reef (2-3 dives). Possibility to see oceanic whitetip (Longimanus) and hammerhead sharks. Evening coastal night dive, followed by an overnight cruise north towards Safaga. Day 7: Two relaxed morning dives, typically at Panorama Reef, then a smooth return cruise to Hurghada, arriving around 14:30. Optional desert quad safari in the afternoon or early evening. Day 8: Disembarkation and transfer to the airport or hotel. Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons (Please note that night dives are not allowed in Marine Parks)

Expedition Elba::11.programme:
Program
Day 1: Meet & greet at the airport or hotel. Transfer to Port Ghalib, check-in, onboard briefing and overnight in port. Day 2: Southbound cruise with a relaxed check dive at Marsa Shouni, followed by an afternoon dive at Shaab Marsa Alam and a night dive. Overnight crossing towards Rocky and Zabargad Islands. Day 3: Full day at Rocky Island and Zabargad. Expect dramatic walls, pristine reefs and a unique sense of diving history and isolation. Days 4-5: Exploration of the rarely visited Elba region. Two days of pristine reefs, vibrant corals and virtually untouched dive sites — a true expedition highlight far from regular liveaboard routes. Days 6-7: Two full days at St. John’s. Dive a spectacular maze of caverns, swim-throughs, drop-offs and colourful coral gardens, with schooling fish and frequent pelagic encounters. Night dives when conditions allow. Days 8-9: Sataya and Fury Shoals. From dolphin encounters in Sataya’s vast lagoon to the labyrinth of reefs, pinnacles and coral gardens of Fury Shoals, these days showcase the southern Red Sea at its most diverse and playful. Day 10: A full day at the iconic Elphinstone Reef. Steep walls, rich coral growth and excellent chances for pelagic encounters make this one of the highlights of the expedition. Day 11: Early morning dive at Elphinstone, followed by a relaxed dive at Abu Dabab during the northbound cruise back towards Port Ghalib. Day 12: Disembarkation and transfer to the airport or hotel. Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons (Please note that night dives are not allowed in Marine Parks)

Fury Shoals Dolphin Trip::7.programme:
Program
Day 1: Our friendly staff will welcome you at the airport. Bus transfer from the airport to the marina. You will, then, be assigned a cabin and discover the boat. Day 2: After breakfast, your guide will tell you everything you need to know about your programme of the week, safety recommendations and, more generally, your life on the boat. Your diving certifications, logbook and insurance will be checked before leaving the marina. The boat will then sail to the first dive site, 30 minutes away from the marina. Your guide will give you a detailed briefing about your first dive. After lunch you will do your second dive. Day 3: At the break of dawn, you will start your day of diving on the drop-offs of Daedalus. You will do three dives there (at least ten different dives can be organised on this huge reef). You will do two dives on the northern part of the reef to maybe have the opportunity to encounter the hammerhead sharks in the blue. In the afternoon, you will dive on the western side. The light will be perfect at that time of day and you will be amazed by the coral diversity of this part of the reef. Between the dives you will have the opportunity to visit the lighthouse with the authorisation of the keepers Day 3-5: On the first day, enjoy an exciting dive outside the Sataya lagoon. On the second day, experience snorkeling with dolphins in their natural habitat. For the third day, it's up to you—choose between swimming with dolphins again or trying an introduction dive to explore the underwater world. Throughout your trip, various activities like diving, snorkeling along the reef, or simply relaxing under a starry sky after dinner await you. Day 6: After breakfast, a dolphin excursion and a dive for certified divers will be organized. You will then sail approximately 5 to 6 hours north to reach the site of Sheleneyat. You can take a snorkeling hike along the reef. After dinner, time to party! Day 7: At the break of dawn, the boat will sail to the Marsa Alam area where you will go diving or snorkeling on the two sites selected by your guide. You will arrive at the marina early in the afternoon. Your guide will tell you all about the leisure activities you can book in the Marsa Alam area to spend an entertaining Friday afternoon. Day 8: At the break of dawn, the boat will sail to the Marsa Alam area where you will go diving or snorkeling on the two sites selected by your guide. You will arrive at the marina early in the afternoon. Your guide will tell you all about the leisure activities you can book in the Marsa Alam area to spend an entertaining Friday afternoon. Complimentary airport transfers for departures at the end of the cruise. This service is available if your flight is scheduled for before 4:00 PM. Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons (Please note that night dives are not allowed in Marine Parks)

Golden Triangle::7.programme:
Program
Day 1: Our friendly staff will welcome you at the airport. Bus transfer from the airport to the marina. You will, then, be assigned a cabin and discover the boat. Check-in 3 PM *1st day of cruise: Complimentary airport pick-up for guests arriving at Marsa Alam Airport or Hurghada Airport after 2:00 PM. For arrivals before this time, we can arrange a transfer package at an additional cost. Day 2: After breakfast, your guide will tell you everything you need to know about your programme of the week, safety recommendations, and, more generally, your life on the boat. Your diving certifications, logbook, and insurance will be checked before leaving the marina. The boat will then sail to the first dive site, 30 minutes away from the marina. Your guide will give you a detailed briefing about your first dive. The second dive will be done in the afternoon. After dinner, the boat will head towards the Brothers Islands for a six-hour trip. Day 3: Brother Islands Arrive the day before on site, you will do three daytime dives on the stunning drop-offs of the Brothers Islands. Due to new regulations aimed at protecting the marine ecosystem, safari boats are only allowed to spend one day on the Brothers'site. You will then sail all night long to reach Daedalus at the break of dawn. Day 4: Daedalus Arrive early in the morning, and you will do three daytime dives on the amazing drop-off of Daedalus, home of the hammerhead shark. A visit to the lighthouse will be organised by the guide with the authorisation of the keepers. Day 5: Daedalus According to the weather forecast and customers' requests, you will do two or three more dives on Daedalus before sailing towards the coast. It will take about seven hours to reach the site of Abu Dabbab, where you will spend the night. According to your time of arrival, a night dive may be organised. Day 6: Elphinstone According to the weather forecast, you will do two or three dives on the stunning drop-offs of Elphinstone. Then the boat will sail back to Abu Dabbab to spend the night in a protected area. If a night dive has not been organized the day before, then we will organize it on this day. Day 7: According to the weather forecast and your flight schedules, you will do one or two more dives in the morning. After the last dive, you will have the possibility to rinse all your diving gear on the diving deck at the rear of the boat before sailing for 2 hours to Port Ghalib. This programme is based on a departure from Port Ghalib; it can be modified without prior notice by the captain and/or the guide according to the weather conditions. Day 8: Departure from the boat will be after breakfast or according to your flight and transfer schedules to the airport or hotel. Check-out 10 AM *Last day of cruise: Complimentary airport transfers for departures at the end of the cruise. This service is available if your flight is scheduled for before 4:00 PM. Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons (Please note that night dives are not allowed in Marine Parks)

Program
Day 1: Our friendly staff will welcome you at the airport. Bus transfer from the airport to the marina. You will, then, be assigned a cabin and discover the boat. Check-in 3 PM *1st day of cruise: Complimentary airport pick-up for guests arriving at Marsa Alam Airport or Hurghada Airport after 2:00 PM. For arrivals before this time, we can arrange a transfer package with an additional cost. Day 2: After breakfast, your guide will tell you everything you need to know about your programme of the week, safety recommendations, and, more generally, your life on the boat. Your diving certifications, logbook, and insurance will be checked before leaving the marina. The boat will then sail to the first dive site, 30 minutes away from the marina. Your guide will give you a detailed briefing about your first dive. After lunch you will do your second dive. Day 3: Daedalus At sunrise, you will start your day of diving at the Daedalus Falls. Your guide will suggest three dives. This reef offers you ten different dives. You will make 2 dives north of the reef for perhaps the chance to observe hammerhead sharks. In the afternoon, you will dive west of the reef, where the coral diversity is impressive. This slope also offers perfect light in the afternoon. Between dives, you will have the opportunity to visit the Daedalus lighthouse. In the early evening, after dinner, the boat will continue its journey all night south to arrive in the early morning under the Tropic of Cancer at Rocky Island and Zabargad. Day 4: Rocky and Zabargad islands You will make three dives around the Rocky and Zabargad islands. The navigation times between the sites vary from 30 to 45 minutes between the islands. The dive sites are carefully chosen by your guide depending on the weather and the number of boats on the sites. Day 5: Saint John's In the early morning, the captain and his crew will take you to the Saint John's sites. Three dives will be offered to you. Navigation times between sites vary between 30 minutes and 1 hour and 30 minutes in the Saint John's area. The dive sites are carefully chosen by your guide depending on the weather and the number of boats on the sites. Day 6: Fury Shoals That day, we will start the ascent to the north. On the way, we will stop at Sataya (Dolphin house) located in the Fury Shoals area, where you may have the opportunity to swim with the dolphins. We will then continue our ascent to the Sheleneyat site in the Wadi Gemal area, where the third dive of the day will take place at dusk or at night. Day 7: Elphinstone Reef In the early morning, you will arrive in the Marsa Alam area, on the mythical Elphinstone Reef. You will make 2 dives there, before sailing another two hours to arrive in the early afternoon at the Port Ghalib marina. You can use the platform to rinse your equipment. Your guide will also suggest various extra diving activities to keep you busy on Friday afternoon. Day 8: Departure from the boat will be after breakfast or according to your flight and transfer schedules to the airport or hotel. Check-out 10 AM *Last day of cruise: Complimentary airport transfers for departures at the end of the cruise. This service is available if your flight is scheduled for before 4:00 PM. Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons (Please note that night dives are not allowed in Marine Parks)

North Brothers::7.programme:
Program
Day 1: Our friendly staff will welcome you at the airport. Bus transfer from the airport to the marina. You will, then, be assigned a cabin and discover the boat. Check-in 3 PM *1st day of cruise: Complimentary airport pick-up for guests arriving at Marsa Alam Airport or Hurghada Airport after 2:00 PM. For arrivals before this time, we can arrange a transfer package at an additional cost. Day 2: After breakfast, your guide will tell you everything you need to know about your programme of the week, safety recommendations, and, more generally, your life on the boat. Your diving certifications, logbook, and insurance will be checked before leaving the marina. The boat will then sail to the first dive site, 30 minutes away from the marina. Your guide will give you a detailed briefing about your first dive. After lunch, you will do your second dive. You will then keep sailing north to reach the El Gouna area, where you will spend a quiet and peaceful night moored behind a big reef. Day 3: Abu Nuhas Arrive the day before on site, you will do your first two wreck dives in the morning. After lunch you will sail north for two hours before reaching the site where you will do the third dive of the day. Upon request, a night dive may be added. For a quiet and peaceful night, you will spend the night away from the waves, moored behind a big reef. This programme may be subject to change according to weather conditions. Day 4: Thistlegorm Discover the fascinating history of this World War II cargo ship, now an underwater museum teeming with marine life. Explore its holds filled with trucks, motorcycles, and war supplies, all encrusted in corals. Each dive reveals new secrets, making it a truly unforgettable experience for every diver. Day 5: Ras Muhammad Marine Park At the break of dawn, the boat will sail to the Ras Muhammad Marine Park where you will dive twice on the dizzying drop-offs among thousands of colourful fishes. After lunch, the boat will start heading south. The third dive will either be done on a beautiful coral garden or on a shipwreck. Upon request (and according to the site and weather), a night dive may be added. Day 6: Brothers Islands Arrived in the early morning, you will make three dives during the day on the magnificent drop offs of the Brothers. A tour of the lighthouse can be organized by your guide according to agreements with the guards on site. The captain and his crew will then sail for around five hours to arrive at night in the Safaga area. Day 7: Departure from the boat will be after breakfast or according to your flight and transfer schedules to the airport or hotel. Check-out 10AM *Last day of cruise : Complimentary airport transfers for departures at the end of the cruise. This service is available if your flight is scheduled for before 4:00 PM. Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons (Please note that night dives are not allowed in Marine Parks)

North Dahab Tiran::7.programme:
Program
Day 1: Our team will welcome you to the airport. You will be transferred by bus to the marina. Your cabin will then be assigned, and you can begin to explore the boat. Check-in 3 PM *1st day of cruise: Complimentary airport pick-up for guests arriving at Marsa Alam Airport or Hurghada Airport after 2:00 PM. For arrivals before this time, we can arrange a transfer package at an additional cost. Day 2: After breakfast, a welcome briefing will be presented by the guide, covering the week's organization, onboard safety instructions, etc. Your diving documents and insurance will be checked before leaving the marina. The captain will set course to the first diving site, which is 30 minutes from departure, where the briefing for the "refresher" dive will be conducted. After lunch, you will perform the second dive of the day in the Hurghada area before continuing your journey north to reach the area of El Gouna, where you will spend the night at a site sheltered from the waves. Day 3: Tiran On this third day of the cruise, you will have the opportunity to explore the island of Tiran. Located near the tip of Sinai, this island offers three unique dives at three different sites. The first diving site, Thomas Reef, features a rich drop-off and a plateau to the west, where you may be lucky enough to spot sharks. You will then dive at Jackson Reef, followed by a dive at Gordon Reef. Afterward, you will head towards Ras Abou Gallum. Day 4: Dahab and Nabq Explore the wonders of Dahab and Nabq, two iconic diving spots in Sinai. In Dahab, dive the Blue Hole and Canyon, known for dramatic drop-offs and vibrant marine life. Nabq offers tranquil waters, coral plateaus, and mangroves, with turtles and rays for all-level divers. Day 5: Ras Mohamed and the Thistlegorm Discover the best of Ras Mohamed and the Thistlegorm, two iconic Red Sea dive sites. Ras Mohamed offers vibrant coral reefs, dramatic walls, and abundant marine life, making it a must-see for divers. At the Thistlegorm, explore the legendary WWII shipwreck, filled with fascinating artifacts and surrounded by schools of fish, creating a perfect mix of history and underwater adventure. Day 6: Thistlegorm and Abu Nuhas Dive into history and beauty at Thistlegorm and Abu Nuhas, two legendary Red Sea sites. Thistlegorm, a WWII shipwreck, reveals fascinating artifacts and vibrant marine life. Abu Nuhas, the "Shipwreck Graveyard, "offers stunning dives on multiple wrecks, each teeming with fish and coral, blending adventure with underwater exploration. Day 7: The last two dives of the week will be conducted in Hurghada or Safaga, depending on the return marina. Stunning drop-offs await to make a grand finale of your week. The boat is scheduled to return in the afternoon. You will have the opportunity to rinse your equipment on the rear platform of the boat or take a stroll in Safaga/Hurghada. Depending on your flight schedule, other activities may be offered to fully enjoy your Friday afternoon. St John's Reefs::7.programme:
Program
Day 1: Arrival Our friendly staff will welcome you at the airport. Bus transfer from the airport to the marina. You will, then, be assigned a cabin and discover the boat. Day 2: Gota Sharm After breakfast, your guide will tell you everything you need to know about your program of the week, safety recommendations, and, more generally, your life on the boat. Your diving certifications, logbook, and insurance will be checked before leaving the marina. The boat will then sail to the first dive site, 30 minutes away from the marina. Your guide will give you a detailed briefing about your first dive. After lunch, you will sail for about two hours heading south to reach the dive site called “Gota Sharm” where you will do your second dive. After dinner, the boat will sail all night long, crossing the Tropic of Cancer on its way, to reach the Saint John's reef area at the break of dawn. Day 3: Saint John's Reef 3 dives will be organised. The sailing time between the dive sites varies from 15 to 30 min. The dive sites are carefully selected by your guide according to the weather forecast and the number of boats already moored on the site. For a quiet and peaceful night, you will spend the night moored behind a big reef. Day 4: Saint John's At sunrise, the captain and his crew will take you to another fantastic dive site of Saint John's reef for another great day of diving. Day 5: Saint John's & Fury Shoals After a final dive at St. John’s Reef, we head north for a legendary dive at the caves of Um Kararim. Next, we'll arrive at Sataya (Dolphin House) in the Fury Shoals, with a chance to snorkel with dolphins, depending on the light. The third dive will take place at dusk or night, with the boat anchored at Sataya Reef for the night. Day 6: Fury Shoals & Sheleneyat If the dolphin snorkeling session wasn’t done the day before, we will organize it this morning, followed by two dives on stunning Fury Shoals reefs. After lunch, we'll sail north for 5 hours to "Sheleneyat," where the third dive will be at dusk or night, depending on arrival time. After dinner, enjoy a surprise Egyptian event hosted by the captain and crew. Day 7: Marsa Alam The boat will sail for 45 minutes to your first dive site of the day. After breakfast, we'll head north for two hours to the Marsa Alam area for the final dive. Afterward, you can rinse your gear on the diving deck before a 30-minute sail to the marina, with an estimated arrival at 2:00 PM. Your guide will provide details about leisure activities available in Marsa Alam for an enjoyable Friday afternoon. Day 8: Departure Departure from the boat will be after breakfast or according to your flight and transfer schedules to the airport or hotel. Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons (Please note that night dives are not allowed in Marine Parks)

Ultra South Reef Elba::10.programme:
Program
Day 1: Our friendly staff will welcome you at the airport. Bus transfer from the airport to the marina. You will, then, be assigned a cabin and discover the boat. Day 2: After breakfast, a welcome briefing will be presented by the guide. A check of your diving documents and insurance will be conducted. The captain will then set course for the first dive site, approximately 30 minutes from departure. The 'Check Dive' briefing will be given by the guide. The second dive will take place in the afternoon. Day 3: On this day, you will have the opportunity to explore the Daedalus site with three dives, where you may encounter the thrilling spectacle of hammerhead sharks. This remote reef is known for its deep drop-offs, vibrant coral walls, and diverse marine life, making it an ideal location for exciting and memorable dives. Each dive presents a unique chance to spot these majestic predators as they glide through the deep blue waters, alongside other fascinating marine species. Day 4: You will undertake three dives around the Rocky and Zabargad Islands. The navigation times between the sites vary from 30 to 45 minutes between the islands. The dive sites are carefully selected by your guide based on the weather and the number of boats at the sites. Day 5-6: On the first day at Elba, you will arrive at the Shaab Kabrit reef to begin with two dives on the Isola Di Levanzo wreck, followed by a third dive on the reef itself. Continuing within the Elba Nature Reserve, the captain will navigate to Gota Kabrit, where you will dive after a 1-hour and 30-minute journey. The adventure continues with a second dive at the Habili Shalal site, and finally, a last dive at the Ohrob site, located 2 hours and 30 minutes away. Day 7: After spending two days on the Elba Reef, you will head north to the Abu Fendira area, near Saint John's. Three dives will be carried out at Abu Fendira. Day 8: In the early morning, the captain and his crew will take you to the Saint John's sites. Three dives will be offered. Navigation times between the sites vary between 30 minutes and 1 hour and 30 minutes in the Saint John's area. Dive sites are carefully selected by your guide based on the weather and the number of boats at the sites. Day 9: We continue our journey northward. On the way, we will stop at Sataya, located in the Fury Shoals area, where you may have the opportunity to swim with dolphins. Three dives will be conducted in the area. Day 10: In the early morning, you will arrive in the Marsa Alam area, at the legendary Elphinstone Reef. You will do 2 dives there before sailing for another two hours to arrive at the Port Ghalib marina in the early afternoon. You can use the rear platform to rinse your equipment. Your guide will also offer various non-diving activities to keep you occupied on Friday afternoon. Day 11: Departure from the boat will be after breakfast or according to your flight and transfer schedules to the airport or hotel. Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons (Please note that night dives are not allowed in Marine Parks)

Reefs & Wrecks::7.programme:
Program
Day 1: Meet & greet at the airport. Group transfer to the port. Onboarding, meeting the crew & briefing. Days 2-6: Departing & check dive. Safari according to the planned route. The famous horseshoe-shaped reef of Shaab El Erg is a perfect example of the reefs on offer on this cruise with its beautiful hard coral garden and the chance to see dolphins. Abu Nuhas has four well-known wrecks: Giannis D, Carnatic, the Chrisoula K ('tile wreck') and the Kimon M ('lentil wreck'), all offering spectacular dives and plenty of fish life. In between wreck dives you will also visit the reefs of the Straits of Gubal, Gulf of Suez and those to the north of Hurghada. A variety of deep walls and hard coral gardens with an abundance of reef fish make them well worth a visit. Night dives can be superb as Gubal Island offers protected anchoring for the night. A small wreck at 8-10 meters makes for a spectacular night dive with lionfish, scorpionfish and its resident giant moray eel as well as the wreck of the Ulysses. Next onto the Kingston lying at Shag Rock, the Carina lying close to Sha'ab Ali and the Dunraven at Beacon Rock. Day 7: 2 dives on the last day. Return to the port. Day 8: Check-out from the yacht, group transfer to the airport. Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons (Please note, that night dives are not available in Marine Parks)

South & St. Johns::7.programme:
Program
Day 1: Meet & greet at the airport. Group transfer to the port. Onboarding, meeting the crew & briefing. Days 2-6: Departing & check dive. Safari according to the planned route. This trip takes you to some of the best diving the Red Sea has to offer. Here the diving is less arduous so it's a trip for those who want to see the best but have a more relaxed time while doing so. Sailing to the southernmost reefs, you'll depart from Marsa Ghalib Port and dive some sites to the South before sailing overnight to your southernmost point in the St. John's area. Depending on the weather, government approval and marine life sightings in recent weeks, we may sail to the southernmost islands of Rocky and Zabargad, or we'll moor instead in the vast reef system of St John's to begin the adventure in the South. On the way to Fury Shoals, dive Sha'ab Sharm with its wall dives and white tip reef sharks. Oceanic whitetips and silky sharks can sometimes be found in the blue and turtles often visit the south side before heading further south. At Fury Shoals, dive Sha'ab Claude with its famous swim-throughs and huge porite corals. Whitetip reef sharks and an anemone and clownfish settlement can be seen a little off the reef to the South. Abu Galawa Soraya has a fantastic coral garden and a wreck of a private sailing boat populated with glassfish. Day 7: 2 dives on the last day. Return to the port. Day 8: Check-out from the yacht, group transfer to the airport. Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons (Please note that night dives are not allowed in Marine Parks)

Southern Red Sea Family Adventure::7.programme:
Program
Day 1: Meet & greet at the airport. Group transfer to the port. Onboarding, meeting the crew & briefing. Days 2-6: This is a Red Sea liveaboard designed for families to enjoy together, both in and out of the water. The Southern Red Sea Family Adventure combines diving, snorkelling and marine life encounters with a more relaxed schedule, creating plenty of opportunities to share the experience whether everyone in the family dives or not. Days are spent discovering colourful reefs and the rich marine life of the Southern Red Sea, with opportunities to encounter green turtles and snorkel with wild spinner dolphins. Shorter sailings, mainly coastal dive sites and later starts mean less time travelling and more time enjoying the Red Sea, while diving and snorkelling throughout the week allow family members of different ages and experience levels to get involved. With just 18 berths aboard Emperor Asmaa, departures offer a small-group experience where the emphasis is as much on spending time together as it is on what you see underwater. For families looking for an active Red Sea adventure rather than a traditional family holiday, this is a chance to dive, snorkel, explore and make memories together – above and below the surface. Day 7: 2 dives on the last day. Return to the port. Day 8: Check-out from the yacht, group transfer to the airport. Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons (Please note that night dives are not allowed in Marine Parks)

Southern Solitude::7.programme:
Program
Day 1: Meet & greet at the airport. Group transfer to the port. Onboarding, meeting the crew & briefing. Days 2-6: Departing & check dive. Safari according to the planned route. Southern Solitude is a dive-focused trip, heading out of Port Ghalib and immediately arriving in the Elphinstone area. This enables us to make a check dive nearby and then get straight to a site which is normally frequented on the final days of trips. With fewer boats around it should give the chance to enjoy the 300-metre-long reef’s colourful pink and red soft coral sheer walls in relative peace and quiet. We’ll then go to Daedalus, arriving before most others, to take in its deep walls and drop-offs which offer some of the most spectacular diving to be found, before heading down to the exceptionally remote, and usually quiet, Rocky and Zabargad Islands where even many Red Sea veterans cannot boast to have dived. Over the next couple of days we will move up through St John’s and Fury Shoals where our guides will find the quietest spots in this vast collection of stunning reef system, which offers some of the most picturesque and rewarding diving in the Red Sea. Fury Shoals also boasts an amazing selection of marine life including super-friendly turtles and a resident pod of spinner dolphins. Day 7: 2 dives on the last day. Return to the port. Day 8: Check-out from the yacht, group transfer to the airport. Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons (Please note that night dives are not allowed in Marine Parks)

North & Easy::7.programme:
Program
Day 1: Meet & greet at the airport. Group transfer to the port. Onboarding, meeting the crew & briefing. Day 2: Shaab El Erg for a check dive. Day 3: Dive 1 on either Shark and Yolanda or Shark Observatory, dive 2 either the canyon inside Marsa Bareika or Zatar or Ghozlani. Providing the weather is calm and with no wind, the boat heads straight to Gordon Reef (Tiran) for our first 'open deck' opportunity for either a 3rd dive and a night (or dusk) dive. If the weather is windy, dive at Temple instead for ‘open deck’, 3rd and night (dusk) dive. Day 4: 'Open deck' dive from the boat at Gordon Reef, or a ride on the rib to Thomas Reef for a dive there. Later the boat moves to Jackson for either one or two dives there, or one dive there and then a dive at either Ras Nasrani or Tower before mooring for the night at Temple for the night dive, or instead go straight to Dunraven and night dive on a nearby reef. Day 5: Early departure to Dunraven for dive 1 and dive 2 on the Thistlegorm (or vice versa). Cross to Gubal and moor over the Barge, or 3rd dive at Thistlegorm and leave for Gubal for a dusk or night dive. Day 6: 'Open deck' on the Barge, plus 1 or 2 dives on the Ulysses (weather permitting). Alternatively, guests can opt to choose 4 between 5:30 and 18:30. Option to dive from the rib at Gubal Reef or at Bluff Point (subject to conditions). Day 7: 'Open deck' until 10:00 with the 3rd dive at Shaab El Erg to end the week where we began. Day 8: Check-out from the yacht, group transfer to the airport. Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons

Day 1: Onboarding, meeting the crew & briefing. Days 2: Morning: Check dive at Sharks Bay. The next dive is Jackfish Alley where you can easily enter the small caves there. Days 3: Morning: the first dive of the day will take you to the historical wreck of the Dunraven. The next dive is the Shark and Yolanda Reef, the southernmost tip of the Sinai Peninsula with an endless wall unique in the Red Sea. North & Brothers Islands::7.programme:
Program
Day 1: Arrival from airport to our yacht. Welcome briefing by our Cruise Director & cabin allocation Day 2-6: 3 - 4 dives, including a night dive if permitted by the authorities Itinerary Highlights Offshore Drama Meets Red Sea Legends! The Brothers Islands offer some of the Red Sea’s most thrilling dives, with steep walls, vibrant soft corals, and seasonal encounters with oceanic whitetips, hammerheads, threshers, and manta rays. The Numidia wreck adds a historical touch, lying upright on the reef since 1901 and now home to an abundance of marine life. This itinerary also features iconic northern sites. The SS Thistlegorm is a world-renowned WWII wreck, its cargo still intact and buzzing with fish life. Abu Nuhas delivers two classic wrecks — Giannis D and Carnatic, among others — resting among lively coral gardens. Little Gubal Island is a favourite for both wreck and reef divers, with sites that offer easy conditions, colourful marine life, and hidden treasures like the Barge Wreck, known for its photogenic structure and resident marine species. Rare encounters, from dolphins to unique fish behaviour, are not uncommon here. In Ras Mohamed National Park, sites like Shark Reef and Yolanda Reef stand out for their towering corals and abundant schooling fish. These are just the main highlights — the route includes many other unforgettable sites. North & Brothers Islands is a year-round adventure blending dramatic reefs, wrecks, and exciting seasonal shark encounters Day 7: Max 2 dives on the last day & return to port Day 8: Trip debriefing, check out & airport transfer Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons

North & Safaga::7.programme:
Program
Day 1: Meet & greet at the airport. Group transfer to the port. Onboarding, meeting the crew & briefing. Days 2-6: Departing & check dive. Safari according to the planned route. The North & Safaga route is a showcase of the Red Sea’s finest - where wrecks aren’t just steel on the seabed, but thriving ecosystems; and reefs aren’t just coral gardens, but underwater cities alive with movement. This is a trip designed for divers who want both heart-pounding exploration and rich, colourful reef life - without compromise. Drift through the kaleidoscopic walls of Ras Mohamed National Park, then descend into the wartime legacy of the SS Thistlegorm, a dive that never fails to impress. At Abu Nuhas Reef, dive into one of the Red Sea’s most renowned wreck sites, where multiple shipwrecks, including the Carnatic, Giannis D, and others, are nestled among vibrant coral formations and teeming with marine life. Further south, the sheer walls of Panorama Reef or Abu Kifan bring big blue drama and the chance of encounters with pelagics. Then, take a quieter moment at the Salem Express - a haunting site that divers often describe as unforgettable. Round off the journey with relaxed dives around Little Gubal Island, where calm waters and the possibility of dolphin sightings offer the perfect finale. For wreck lovers, reef enthusiasts, and those who simply want the best of both - North & Safaga is one of the most rewarding itineraries in the Red Sea. Day 7: 2 dives on the last day. Return to the port. Day 8: Check-out from the yacht, group transfer to the airport. Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons

North Including Tiran & Dahab::7.programme:
Program
Day 1: Arrival from airport to our yacht. Welcome briefing by our Cruise Director & cabin allocation Day 2-6: 3 - 4 dives, including a night dive if permitted by the authorities Itinerary Highlights Exploring the Northern Red Sea with Dahab as a Bonus! This route takes you on a thrilling dive journey through some of the most iconic and diverse sites the Red Sea has to offer. From the lush reefs of Tiran to the dramatic landscapes of Dahab, every stop offers something unforgettable. Wreck lovers will be in their element at the legendary SS Thistlegorm, a true underwater time capsule from WWII, and the famous Abu Nuhas reef, where the Giannis D and Chrisoula K lie fused into rich coral gardens teeming with life. Gubal Island brings its own charm, offering a mix of wreck exploration and colourful reef diving — ideal for divers who want it all. As you head north, the jagged peaks of the Sinai Mountains rise into view, adding a dramatic backdrop to the adventure. And beyond the headline sites, this itinerary is packed with hidden gems that surprise even seasoned divers. To take full advantage of the depth and variety this trip offers, divers should hold an Advanced Open Water certification or Deep Dive Speciality — both available onboard if you’re ready to level up mid-expedition. Day 7: Max 2 dives on the last day & return to port Day 8: Trip debriefing, check out & airport transfer Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons

North: Wrecks & Reefs::7.programme:
Program
Day 1: Arrival from airport to our yacht. Welcome briefing by our Cruise Director & cabin allocation Day 2-6: 3 - 4 dives, including a night dive if permitted by the authorities Itinerary Highlights The Best of Both Worlds — Legendary Wrecks and Thriving Reefs! The North: Wrecks & Reefs itinerary blends iconic wrecks with vibrant reefs, offering an exceptional dive experience. The SS Thistlegorm, one of the world’s most famous wrecks, is home to a variety of marine life and wartime relics from its 1941 sinking. At Abu Nuhas Reef, the wrecks of the Giannis D and Carnatic rest where they collided with the reef, now surrounded by thriving coral gardens and rich marine life. In the Straits of Tiran, dive sites like Jackson Reef, Woodhouse Reef, and Thomas Reef feature dramatic drop-offs and clear, current-swept waters, with the Sinai Mountains often providing a breathtaking backdrop. Little Gubal Island offers a peaceful mix of reef and wreck diving, where healthy coral, turtles, and dolphins are often encountered — and it’s also a favourite for those with a sharp eye for macro life. In Ras Mohamed National Park, sites like Shark Reef and Yolanda Reef showcase striking coral formations and powerful schooling fish action. These are just some of the main highlights — the region is full of lesser-known sites that are equally unreal, revealing something special on every dive. With the perfect balance of wrecks, reefs, and wild Red Sea beauty, North: Wrecks & Reefs is a route that never gets old. Day 7: Max 2 dives on the last day & return to port Day 8: Trip debriefing, check out & airport transfer Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons

Special Wreck - Thistlegorm - Abu Nuhas.programme:
Program
Day 1: Arrival on board, check-in, equipment setup and dinner on board. Day 2-3: Departure, 2 dives + night dive Itineraries give easy access to dive the best sites of Hurghada and Northern Hurghada, the unique part of the Red Sea with its number of islands and shallow lagoons, drop-offs, and coral gardens. The trip is intended for Advanced Open Water or divers who have 30 meters speciality with 25 logged dives. During this trip, if the weather is with us, you will discover 4 or 5 wrecks. Diving wrecks is amazing as you discover an incredible fauna as nudibranchs, spanish dancers, etc... Expected dive sites depend on the weather conditions and trip duration. At the beginning of your trip • The trip begins in Hurghada and ends in Hurghada • The closest airport is Hurghada Intl (HRG) • Pickup time at the airport is according to your flight. Give yourself enough time to go through immigration and pick up your bags • A representative will be waiting for you at the arrival hall. • Hotel pickup time is in the afternoon, the day prior to departure • You can check in on the boat as of 4:30 pm on the day prior to departure. • The boat departs Hurghada in the morning at 08:30 AM. The end of your trip • Your last dives will be on the last day in the morning. • It is your responsibility to ensure you respect the 24-hour no-fly time after your last dive! • The boat docks back in Hurghada in the afternoon on the last day • Check-out or disembarkation is at the arrival of the last day. Some of our highlight dive sites: • SS Thistlegorm * Ras Mohammed * Bluff Point (small Gubal island), Wreck of Ulysses. • The Wrecks of Shaab Abu Nuhas: Giannis D, The Carnatic, Chrisoula K, Kimon M. • Umm Usk, Siyul Islands, Blind Reef, Shaab El Erg (Dolphin House). • Umm, Gamaar Island, Carless Reef, and all sites around. • Giftun Islands, Abu Ramada Island, and all reefs around. • Wreck of Balena. • Abu Hasheesh Island and all the are Day 4: 3 dives + night dive. Day 5: 2 dives and back to the marina, check out. Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure, or other similar reasons (Please note that night dives are not allowed in Marine Parks)

Best of North (Wrecks) - Tiran - Brother.programme:
Program
Day 1: Meet & greet at the airport. Group transfer to the port. Onboarding, meeting the crew & briefing. Day 2: Departure after approval by the port police at approximately 9:00; check dive and 1- 2 further dives at various dive sites around Hurghada. Days 3-5: Three dives and one night dive each day at the best wrecks in the north. Days 6 and 7: Three dives and one night dive each day at the best sites in the Strait of Tiran. Crossing to Brother Island during the night of day 6. Days 8 and 9: Three day dives each at the Brothers Islands. Days 10 and 11: Three dives and one night dive each day at the best dive sites around Safaga. Return to Hurghada on the evening of day 10. Day 12: 2 dives in the area around Hurghada, arrival in the port at approximately 4:00 PM or, if possible (depending on, for example, transfer planning for the departure day or necessary work on board), we will also spend the last night at sea near the port. Day 13: Check-out from the yacht, group transfer to the airport. Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons (Please note, that night dives are not available in Marine Parks)

Deep South Red Sea Expedition::12.programme:
Program
Day 1: ARRIVAL IN MARSA ALAM – HAMATA Arrival by flight at Marsa Alam International Airport (RMF). Guests will be transferred from Marsa Alam Airport to Hamata, with a transfer time of approximately 2 hours. Upon arrival: - Check-in on board NEW LIFE - Welcome and introduction to the crew and professional dive guides - Safety briefing - Equipment preparation - Dinner on board - Overnight on board in Hamata Day 2: CHECK DIVES – FURY SHOAL The expedition begins with check dives in the spectacular Fury Shoal area. Shaab Claudio An easy and beautiful orientation dive through an impressive cave and swim-through system. This is the perfect opportunity to become familiar with the diving conditions and explore the spectacular underwater formations. Sataya Reef – South / Dolphin House A spectacular reef area famous for encounters with spinner dolphins. Sightings are very likely and can provide an unforgettable wildlife experience. Afternoon Departure – St. John’s In the afternoon, NEW LIFE departs towards St. John’s Reefs. Approximate crossing time: 7 hours, depending on sea and weather conditions. Day 3-11: ST. JOHN’S REEFS Habili Ali A spectacular open-water wall dive with the possibility of encountering reef sharks. The steep wall drops into the deep blue and offers an impressive Red Sea diving experience. Gota Kebira A huge coral formation and an ideal location for a drift dive along the reef wall, with impressive coral formations and abundant marine life. A further dive at Gota Kebira may be scheduled depending on the conditions and the daily dive plan. Departure – Abu Fendera After the diving program, NEW LIFE departs towards Abu Fendera. Approximate crossing time: 7 hours. Day 4: ABU FENDERA – THE GATEWAY TO PRISTINE REEFS Today we explore the remote and largely untouched reef systems of Abu Fendera. Abu Fendera North A very remote reef system featuring impressive giant pillar corals and pristine underwater landscapes. Abu Fendera East A spectacular drift dive along untouched reef areas with beautiful macro life and soft corals. Abu Fendera West A shallower and more relaxed dive, allowing guests to enjoy the reef and marine life at a comfortable pace. Departure – Elba Reef After the final dive, NEW LIFE departs towards Elba Reef. Approximate crossing time: 7 hours. Day 5: ELBA REEF – INTO THE REMOTE SOUTH Arrival at the remote Elba Reef, one of the most pristine and untouched diving areas of the Red Sea. Up to three dives at spectacular steep walls and colourful coral reefs, with excellent opportunities to encounter sharks, eagle rays, barracuda and large schools of fish. The remote location and limited diver traffic make Elba Reef one of the true highlights of the expedition. Day 6: ELBA REEF – EXPLORING PRISTINE REEFS Continue exploring the unique reef system of Elba Reef with up to three dives at varied steep walls, coral gardens and reef plateaus. Crystal-clear water, healthy coral formations and exceptional marine biodiversity make Elba Reef one of the absolute highlights of this expedition. Day 7: ELBA REEF – FINAL DIVES & DEPARTURE FOR ST. JOHN’S Enjoy the final dives around Elba Reef, depending on weather, sea conditions and the planned itinerary. Early Afternoon – Departure for St. John’s In the early afternoon, NEW LIFE departs Elba Reef and heads towards St. John’s Reefs. Approximate crossing time: 14 hours, depending on sea and weather conditions. Overnight sailing towards the spectacular reefs of St. John’s. Day 8: ST. JOHN’S & ST. JOHN’S CAVES Arrival in the St. John’s area and a full day of diving. Explore spectacular reef formations, walls, caves and underwater passages in this remote southern Red Sea region. St. John’s Caves A highlight of the area, featuring impressive caves, tunnels and swim-throughs combined with colourful coral formations and rich marine life. The exact dive sites and number of dives will depend on local conditions and the final itinerary. Day 9: SATAYA – GOTTA SORAYA; GOTTA KEBIR – SHILINIAT The expedition continues towards Sataya and the surrounding reef systems. Gotta Soraya & Gotta Kebir Explore spectacular reef formations with impressive coral structures, walls and abundant marine life. Shiliniat Continue exploring the reef system of Shiliniat, depending on the prevailing conditions and the dive plan for the day. Day 10: SHAAB MARSA ALAM – ELPHINSTONE – ABU DABAB The expedition continues north with a diverse selection of renowned dive locations. Shaab Marsa Alam Explore the reef formations and marine life of Shaab Marsa Alam. Elphinstone Reef One of the most famous reefs in the Egyptian Red Sea, offering spectacular walls, colourful coral formations and opportunities for encounters with larger pelagic marine life. Abu Dabab A well-known reef area offering varied diving and the opportunity to explore its rich marine environment. Day 11: MARSA SHONA – MARSA TROMBI – MANGROVE BAY Continue north with a full day of diving along the Red Sea coast. Marsa Shona Explore the reef and diverse marine life of Marsa Shona. Marsa Trombi Continue to Marsa Trombi for another dive and discover its reef formations and marine environment. Mangrove Bay A relaxed and scenic diving experience surrounded by the characteristic coastal landscape. The exact number and timing of dives depend on the conditions and the final itinerary. Day 12: SALEM EXPRESS – RETURN TO PORT Today features a dive at the legendary Salem Express, one of the best-known wrecks in the Egyptian Red Sea. After the diving program, NEW LIFE returns to the port at approximately 13:00. The afternoon is at leisure: - Relax and enjoy the facilities on board - Free time to explore the surrounding area - Prepare equipment and luggage - Final evening aboard NEW LIFE Day 13 : CHECK-OUT & DEPARTURE After breakfast, guests check out from NEW LIFE. A transfer to the airport will then be arranged for the guests' individual journey home. The itinerary is designed as an expedition and may be adjusted according to weather, wind, sea conditions, tides, local regulations, port requirements and operational considerations. The exact sequence of dive sites and number of dives may therefore change. The final itinerary is determined by the Captain and professional dive guides, always with safety as the highest priority. The remote southern itinerary includes destinations such as Elba Reef, Abu Fendera and St. John's, making this an exceptional expedition for experienced divers seeking pristine reefs, spectacular walls, abundant marine life and remote Red Sea diving.

Deep South Red Sea Expedition::14.programme:
Program
Day 1 – 24 July ARRIVAL IN HURGHADA – CHECK-IN ON BOARD Guests arrive in Hurghada and check in on board NEW LIFE. - Check-in and cabin allocation - Welcome on board - Meet the crew and professional dive guides - Safety briefing - Equipment preparation - Dinner on board - Overnight on board in Hurghada Marina Day 2 – 25 July DEPARTURE – HURGHADA → BROTHERS ISLANDS After breakfast, NEW LIFE departs Hurghada and begins the journey towards the legendary Brothers Islands. The crossing takes approximately 8 hours, depending on sea and weather conditions. Once at the destination, the diving program begins according to the conditions and the itinerary. BROTHERS ISLANDS Famous for dramatic walls, strong currents, colorful soft corals and frequent encounters with oceanic whitetip sharks, hammerhead sharks, grey reef sharks and thresher sharks. The Brothers are also home to the legendary wrecks Aida II and Numidia. DAEDALUS REEF An isolated offshore reef known for spectacular drop-offs, pristine coral formations and excellent opportunities to encounter hammerhead sharks, oceanic whitetips and large pelagic species. ROCKY ISLAND One of the most remote and untouched dive sites in the Red Sea. Steep walls covered with colourful soft corals attract tuna, barracuda, grey reef sharks and other pelagic fish. ZABARGAD ISLAND A beautiful island surrounded by crystal-clear waters, coral gardens, caves and steep reef walls. Frequent encounters include turtles, Napoleon wrasse and reef sharks. ST. JOHN'S REEFS A vast reef system in the far south featuring tunnels, caverns, pinnacles, drop-offs and coral gardens. St. John's is known for its exceptional biodiversity and spectacular underwater landscapes. ELBA REEF Located close to the Egyptian-Sudanese border, Elba offers pristine reefs with minimal diver traffic, healthy coral formations and abundant marine life in an untouched environment. ABU FENDERA A remote plateau reef famous for impressive hard coral formations, large schools of fish and excellent visibility. One of the hidden gems of the Southern Red Sea. FURY SHOAL A collection of spectacular reefs featuring caves, swim-throughs, coral gardens and sheltered lagoons. Highlights include Shaab Claudio, Shaab Maksour and Malahi, often referred to as the “Underwater Labyrinth.” MARINE LIFE Oceanic Whitetip Sharks • Hammerhead Sharks • Grey Reef Sharks • Silvertip Sharks • Thresher Sharks • Turtles • Dolphins • Napoleon Wrasse • Barracuda • Tuna • Giant Trevallies • Eagle Rays • Schools of Anthias and Fusiliers Day 13 – 06 August FINAL DIVES & ARRIVAL IN HAMATA The final morning offers the opportunity for the last dives of the expedition. After the final dives and lunch, NEW LIFE sails towards Hamata. Afternoon – Arrival in Hamata - Arrival in Hamata - Final equipment preparation and packing - Relaxing afternoon on board - Farewell dinner - Last night on board in Hamata Day 14 – 07 August DEPARTURE – HAMATA → HURGHADA After breakfast, it is time to say goodbye to NEW LIFE and the crew. - Breakfast on board - Check-out and disembarkation - Group transfer from Hamata to Hurghada - Estimated transfer time: approximately 5–6 hours End of the Deep South Red Sea Expedition. Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons (Please note that night dives are not allowed in Marine Parks)

Egypt / Elba Reef (Elba borders)::10.programme:
Program
Thursday: Port Ghalib ( Embarkation ) Friday: Shouna for check dive, Elphinstone for 2nd & 3rd dives, sailing to St.John Saturday: Diving St.John the whole day, sailing at night to Elba Sunday: Diving the whole day at Elba reef & night dive. Monday: Diving the whole day at Elba reef & night dive Tuesday: Diving the whole day at Elba reef, sailing at night to St.John Wednesday: St.John for two dives, sailing to Port Ghalib Thursday: Port Ghalib (Disembarkation) Important notes: This itinerary has been specifically tailored for serious divers who want to enjoy the key reefs of the Red Sea in Egypt with no traffic as was the case in the early 1980s, providing an ideal underwater atmosphere for all types of divers, particularly for underwater videographers & photographers. The distance of this itinerary is 600 Nautical Miles Part of the Elba reef is in Sudanese water Special permission has been granted to us from the Egyptian Navy to dive these pristine reefs & remote dive sites which are completely untouched. During this itinerary, we’ll be diving & exploring the famous, untouched, and amazing Italian 113m-long Levanzo wreck, built in March 1901 and sunk on 14th March 1923, lying on one of the beautiful Elba reefs at depths of 22m to 75m. North & Brothers::7.programme:
Program
Day 1: Meet & greet at the airport. Group transfer to the port. Onboarding, meeting the crew & briefing. Day 2: Departure around 8-10 am. Check dive at Sha’ab El Erg, then 2nd and night dive in Gubal Island (depending on weather's conditions). Day 3: 2 dives on Thistlegorm, afterward Dunraven, night dive at Ras Mohamed. Day 4: 1 dive at Ras Mohamed, maybe diving at Abu Nuhas, sailing to Brothers. Day 5: 3 dives at the Brothers, sailing to Safaga. (Please note that night dives are prohibited at all Marine park islands!) Day 6: Diving at Salem Express and Panorama Reef. Sailing to Hurghada area. Possible night dive in Hurghada area. Day 7: Last 2 dives in the Hurghada area. Last night spent in the New Marina Hurghada or in a hotel (depending on the boat's schedule). Day 8: Check-out from the yacht, group transfer to the airport. Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons (Please note that night dives are not allowed in Marine Parks)

North & Safaga::7.programme:
Program

Day 2: Departure around 8-10 am, 2 check dives near Hurghada: Sha’ab el Erg/ Dolphin Reef, possible night dive in Abu Nuhas. Day 3: 2-3 dives in Abu Nuhas and sailing to Ras Mohamed/Sinai. Day 4: 2-3 dives in Ras Mohamed/ Shark Reef, Yolanda, possible night dive at the Thistelgorm wreck. Day 5: 3 dives at Thistlegorm, Shag Rock and Goubal islands, possible night dive. Best of Egypt::14.programme:
Program
Day 1: Meet & greet at the airport. Group transfer to the port. Onboarding, meeting the crew & briefing. Day 2: After breakfast, a welcome briefing (week organization, safety instructions on board, etc.) will be presented by the guide. A check of your diving documents and insurance will be carried out before leaving the marina. The captain will set sail towards the first diving site 30 minutes after departure, during which the "refresher" dive briefing will be conducted. After lunch, you will make the second dive of the day in the Hurghada area, before continuing your navigation to the north to arrive in the El Gouna area where you will spend the night in a sheltered site from the waves. Day 3: For the third day of the cruise, you will have the opportunity to explore the island of Tiran. This island, near the tip of Sinai, offers three unique dives on three different sites. The first diving site, Thomas reef, will allow you to explore a rich drop-off and a plateau to the west, where you may have the chance to encounter sharks. You will then dive at Jackson reef, followed by a dive at Gordon. You will then head towards Ras Abu Gallum. Day 4: In the early morning, you will make your first dive at Ras Abu Gallum. Three dives will be offered in this protected area, which is teeming with life. The first dive on a drop-off, the other two on magnificent coral gardens. Day 5: For the fifth day of the cruise, you will have the chance to discover the Blue Hole of Dahab, a diving and snorkeling site of international renown. You will then have the opportunity to immerse yourself in the diving site called the Canyon, then, as a third dive, the Island, a sublime coral garden that will amaze you. Day 6: At dawn, the boat will sail to the Ras Mohammed marine park where you will dive twice on dizzying drop-offs surrounded by thousands of colorful fish. After lunch, the boat will head northwest. The third dive will take place on the legendary wreck of the SS Thistlegorm, discovered by Cousteau in the 1950s. Day 7: On this day, you will dive at least twice on the wreck of the SS Thistlegorm. Then you will sail for two hours to cross the Gubal strait to reach the small island of Gubal where you will make the third dive. Day 8: In the morning, you will make two first dives on wrecks. After lunch, the captain and his crew will take you further south towards Hurghada, where you will make the third dive of the day. Depending on demand, your guide can organize a night dive. The boat will anchor behind a reef for the night to remain sheltered from the waves. This program may be modified by your guide depending on weather conditions. Day 9: Having arrived the day before on site, you will make three dives during the day on the magnificent drop-offs of the Brothers. Due to a new regulation aimed at protecting the marine ecosystem, cruise ships are no longer allowed to spend more than one day on the Brothers islands. The boat will then sail all night to Daedalus, to arrive in the early morning. Day 10: Three dives will be offered at the Daedalus site, a potential meeting place with hammerhead sharks. A visit to the lighthouse may be organized by your guide depending on agreements with the guardians on site. Day 11: You will make 3 dives around Rocky and Zabargad islands. The navigation time between sites varies from 30 to 45 minutes. Dive sites are carefully chosen by your guide according to weather and the number of boats at the sites. Day 12: In the early morning, the captain and his crew will take you to the St. John's sites. Three dives will be offered. Navigation times between sites vary from 30 minutes to 1 hour 30 minutes in the St. John's area. Dive sites are carefully chosen by your guide depending on weather and the number of boats at the sites. Day 13: This day we will start the journey back north. On the way, we will stop at Sataya (Dolphin House) located in the Fury Shoals area, where you may have the opportunity to swim with dolphins. We will then continue our journey to the Sheleneyat site in the Wadi Gemal area, where the third dive of the day will take place at dusk or at night. Day 14: In the early morning, you will arrive in the Marsa Alam area, on the legendary Elphinstone reef. You will make 2 dives, before sailing for another two hours to arrive in Port Ghalib marina in the early afternoon. You can use the rear platform to rinse your equipment. Your guide will also offer various non-diving activities to keep you busy on Friday afternoon. Day 15: Check-out from the yacht, group transfer to the airport. Routes can be affected by adverse weather conditions and unforeseen events, force majeure or other similar reasons (Please note that night dives are not allowed in Marine Parks)
